svg.title: NET-05-W — Connected waiting for next round
svg.desc: NET-05-waiting-for-next-round on a 1280 by 900 client. Reuses the existing undivided arena, ranking, progress, event, network-status and session-action allocation. A later admitted guest owns waiting players without active bodies. Persistent feedback above network status is noninteractive. No modal, dimming, new action or spectator mode. Top-left diagram coordinates; annotations are outside the client.

g.text: Existing spawned players / terrain / hazards / pickups
Session only scores • Optional scripts disabled
ANNOTATIONS — existing content placeholders are not new interface copy.
Waiting is textual roster state, not living/winner styling or score/result participation. No owned actor.
Keep arena undimmed; feedback captures no focus/input. Existing Tab score access and Leave confirmation remain.
At 1280×720 wrap feedback above network status without covering ranking, events, progress or actions.
Authoritative eligible spawn clears feedback/marker exactly once. UX-NET-05-017–024; NET-ADM-013–016.
